newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Citra Marga to issue $100 mln Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Citra Marga to issue $100 mln Eurobond.

text.p: Indonesian toll-road operator Citra Marga Nusaphala Persada will issue a $100 million Eurobond and a 250 billion rupiah bond in February 1997, Citra corporate finance manager Ilham Wardhana Sriegar said on Wednesday.
He said the Eurobond will carry an interest rate of 8.25 percent and mature in five years, while the Indonesian bond will have an interest rate of 17 percent and mature in seven years.
"We are going to issue the bonds in February 1997," he told an analysts' meeting in Jakarta.
